set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

uuid=$(jq -r .uuid metadata.json)
out="$PWD/$uuid.shell-extension.zip"
stage=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
